THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
STREET & CITY
192
STUDY 142
Purple Velvet Crop & Burnout Skirt
Rights check / Repeats Study 122.
Source: 25023.jpg
Nostalgic, moody, boho
WORKING NOTES
- Keep only one of sections 122 or 142 if you do not need
both.
- The velvet crop and chain belt are the key details.
Try this: Emphasize the velvet crop and chain belt.
IMAGE PROMPT
This is a duplicate of section 122. An
original young woman with long, wavy
honey-blonde hair walks a dirt path
through tall grass. She wears a purple
velvet cropped long-sleeve top with
flared cuffs, a black velvet burnout maxi
skirt with a side slit, and a chain belt with
a cross charm. Tall black boots
complete the look. Soft, late-afternoon
light and blurred trees. Palette of violet,
black, and sage green. Nostalgic and
moody, in the style of a boho gothic
editorial.
